moments.title: BREAKING: 𝕏 wins lawsuit against Australia’s eSafety Commissioner. Elon Musk’s 𝕏 has secured a major victory in Australia’s Federal Court. The eSafety Commissioner argued that 𝕏 should be regulated under two separate onl
moments.selftext: BREAKING: 𝕏 wins lawsuit against Australia’s eSafety Commissioner. Elon Musk’s 𝕏 has secured a major victory in Australia’s Federal Court. The eSafety Commissioner argued that 𝕏 should be regulated under two separate online safety systems because the platform offers DMs and encrypted chat, potentially subjecting it to stricter requirements and penalties of up to A$49.5 million. Justice Elizabeth Raper rejected that argument, ruling that 𝕏 cannot be classified as both a “social media service” and a “relevant electronic service.” A major win for 𝕏 against regulatory overreach.

moments.selftext: 🇺🇸 A women’s-only nude spa is taking this all the way to the Supreme Court. Olympus Spa in Lynnwood, Washington, only allows biological females into its communal nude areas. A transgender woman was turned away, and the state said that was discrimination. Lower courts backed the state, so now the spa is asking the Supreme justices to intervene. This is ultimately about whether sex-based privacy still exists in the most intimate spaces, or whether identity overrides it. The Court is being asked to decide. Source: KomoNews YT / Writer: Val

moments.title: Elon Musk shares major updates on @Starlink “Starlink team has built from nothing, an entire global internet system.” “It’s the first high bandwidth global internet system ever to exist.” “Down the road, it’ll probably b
moments.selftext: Elon Musk shares major updates on @Starlink “Starlink team has built from nothing, an entire global internet system.” “It’s the first high bandwidth global internet system ever to exist.” “Down the road, it’ll probably be, I think, the largest of all internet traffic on Starlink.” “Almost 11,000 satellites in orbit.” “That’s more than twice as many satellites as everyone else combined.” “With the Starlink V3 and beyond, we’ll go to 100,000 satellites.” “We’re now in 167 countries.” “22 million mobile subscribers.” “13 million high bandwidth subscribers.” “Expect these numbers to increase by more than a factor of 10 over time.” “Cloudflare just recently mentioned that based on the current growth, they think probably AI traffic will be 1,000 times more than human internet traffic in five years.” “We’ve got Starshield, which has become a vital part of national security.” “The Starshield team has done amazing work, and it is now a vital part of America’s national security.”
